_doc: Live Operations: every installed stock MP map, its real-world location and the evidence (PLAN.md section 4). Authored data; the mock (make_mock.py) and the future generator read it. pin = [lat, lon]. area = true for a censored/approximate location (drawn as a dashed area circle, the card reads 'Somewhere in ...'). conf: high | medium | approx. campaign = the NEW GAME mission whose pin sits at the same place (the contract ring wraps that pin). Evidence keys: ws = worldspawn message; ld = ui/loading_<map>.urc title; loc = global/localization.txt; scr = maps/<map>.scr header comment / scoreboard text; obj = g_obj_* objective text; tex = BSP texture/sky names; mdl = static models in the BSP; rm = Readme_patch_2.40.txt.

maps.name: Southern France
maps.place: Provence coast, France (Operation Dragoon landing area)
maps.evidence: ws 'South France'; ld + loc 'Southern France'; scr header 'SOUTHERN FRANCE'. Region only, no town named. Pinned on the Dragoon beaches (Aug 1944, the only Allied fighting in southern France) as the most defensible spot.

maps.name: Destroyed Village
maps.evidence: ws/ld/scr 'Destroyed Village' (no place). tex brest/nrmndywlset_1a (the stock Normandy wall set), brest/brstroof. Normandy by its building set; centred in the Caen-Bayeux bocage, between the campaign pins.

maps.name: Remagen
maps.evidence: ld + loc 'Remagen - dm/mohdm3'; scr header 'REMAGEN', scoreboard 'Remagen'; tex interior/remagenchurchrail. Pinned on the Ludendorff Bridge.

maps.name: The Crossroads
maps.evidence: ld + loc + scoreboard 'The Crossroads'; scr header 'THE BRIDGE' (built from obj_team4's geometry). tex french/sign_back, central_europe/frenchdoor. French by its sign/door set only. Pinned in the Massif Central: the nearest spot in France clear of the NEW GAME tags (the Bastogne tag covers north-central France); shares the one 'Somewhere in France' slot with The Bridge.

maps.name: Snowy Park
maps.evidence: ld + loc + scr 'Snowy Park' (no place); tex central_europe_winter/* incl. frozenriver. No national cue in the map; a winter central-European town park, placed in the German theatre (USER TO CONFIRM).

maps.name: Stalingrad
maps.evidence: ws 'Stalingrad'; ld + loc + scr header 'STALINGRAD'. City centre. NOTE: east of the NEW GAME wall map (lon -16.4..40.4) - shown as an edge marker.

maps.name: Algiers
maps.evidence: ld + loc 'Algiers - dm/mohdm7'; scr header 'NORTH AFRIKA', scoreboard 'Algiers'; tex algiers/afrika_map1, casbah wall set. Pinned on the Casbah. (The mod's MP menu mislabels this map 'The Hunt'.)

maps.name: The Hunt
maps.evidence: ld 'The Hunt'; scr header 'THE HUNT'; obj 'Find and destroy the Flak 88 cannon'; tex central_europe/nrmndywlset_2a, brest walls. Normandy by building set; offset from Destroyed Village so the two never share a pin. [liveops 2026-11-10] moved 0.5 deg west (still the Cotentin base, inland Normandy) so its dashed area clears the BASTOGNE tag on the widened v1.10.70 wall.

maps.name: V2 Rocket Facility
maps.evidence: ld 'V2 Rocket Facility'; scr header 'V2 FACILITY'; obj 'Destroy the Control Room / Destroy V2 Rocket'; mdl static_nazibanner. No site named. Peenemuende was rejected: the map does not name it, and wartime V-2 field sites were in France and the Netherlands - so the honest pin is the German theatre.

maps.name: Omaha Beach
maps.evidence: ws 'Omaha Beach'; ld 'Omaha Beach'; scr header 'OMAHA BEACH OBJECTIVE DM'; obj 'Breach the shingle / Destroy two 15cm cannons'. Same spot as campaign pin aa3.

maps.name: The Bridge
maps.evidence: ld 'The Bridge'; scr header 'THE BRIDGE'; obj 'Defend the bridge / Place an explosive under the bridge'; tex french/sign_back, central_europe set (shared with mohdm4). French by its set only (USER TO CONFIRM). Shares the 'Somewhere in France' slot with The Crossroads. [liveops 2026-11-10] Auvergne (still the Massif Central), in the band between the BASTOGNE tag and the printed FRANCE on the widened v1.10.70 wall, so the area's ring stays off the lettering.

maps.name: Bahnhof
maps.evidence: ld + scoreboard 'Bahnhof' (German: railway station). mdl signpost_stlo: the stock road sign whose boards read Rouen / Paris / Londres / Le Mans / Rosel (texture checked) - a Normandy crossroads near Caen. A German name on a French station is consistent with the occupation. Medium-low: the sign is a reused stock asset.

maps.name: Bazaar
maps.evidence: ld + scr 'Bazaar'; tex the stock algiers/* casbah and mosaic set. North African by building set; no city named, so placed inland of the Algiers-Constantine coast, clear of the Algiers and Arzew pins.

maps.name: Brest
maps.evidence: ld + scr header + scoreboard 'Brest'; tex brest/*. (ws reads 'The Bridge' - a leftover from the map it was built from; the game's own name wins.) Same spot as campaign pin aa5.

maps.name: Gewitter
maps.evidence: ld + scoreboard 'Gewitter' (German: thunderstorm), 'Contest Winner by Rungsi'; runs global/weather.scr (rain). No place named; German theatre.

maps.name: Holland
maps.evidence: ld + scr header + scoreboard 'Holland'; tex taholland/hollandroof. Country is certain, town is not; pinned at Arnhem (Market Garden, Sept 1944 - the Spearhead era) and drawn as an area.

maps.name: Malta
maps.evidence: ld + scoreboard 'Malta'; sky/malta; mdl maltasign/maltasign2 (British pub signs 'Three Crowns' and 'Wild Goose', the Valletta waterfront style). Island certain; Valletta is the defensible town.

maps.name: Stadt
maps.evidence: ld + scoreboard 'Stadt' (German: town), 'Contest Winner by Surgeon'. No place named; German theatre.

maps.name: Unterseite
maps.evidence: ld + scr header + scoreboard 'Unterseite' (German: underside), 'Contest Winner by EraserX'. No place named; German theatre.

maps.name: Verschneit
maps.evidence: ld + scoreboard 'Verschneit' (German: snowed-in); tex central_europe_winter/tavernsign. No place named; German theatre, winter.

maps.name: Ardennes
maps.evidence: ld 'Ardennes'; sky/ardennes, taardennes/ardennes_crater; obj 'Control the Flak88 / Detonate the Axis Bunker'. Region certain; drawn as an area just north-east of the Bastogne campaign pin (sh2).

maps.name: Berlin
maps.evidence: ld + scr header 'MP_Berlin_TOW'; tex ta_berlin/*; obj 'Control Radar Dish / Shut Down Flak88s'. Same spot as campaign pin sh3.

maps.name: Druckkammern
maps.place: a U-boat pen on the German coast
maps.evidence: ld 'Druckkammern'; obj 'Disengage U-Boat Clamps / Open Pen Doors / Steal U-Boat'; tex misc_outside/subpen_water2 - a submarine pen. Pen not named. German name, so pinned at Hamburg-Finkenwerder (the Fink II pens) rather than a French Atlantic base; Trondheim is the AA campaign's pen (aa2).

maps.name: Flughafen
maps.evidence: ws + ld 'Flughafen' (German: airport); sky/flughafen; obj 'Open Hangar Doors / Turn On the Runway Lights / Detonate Axis Motorpool'. Airfield not named; German theatre (Rhineland, the Spearhead 1945 front).

maps.name: Bologna
maps.evidence: ws + ld 'Bologna'; scr header 'MP_Bologna_OBJ'; ep2sky/bologna. City centre.

maps.name: Castello
maps.evidence: ws + ld 'Castello' (Italian: castle); scr comment 'snow'; tex german/german_sign_halt_rust. No town named; a snowbound Italian castle fits the northern Apennines in winter 1944-45; centred in the Apennines clear of Bologna and Monte Battaglia.

maps.name: Palermo
maps.evidence: ld + scr header 'MP_Palermo_OBJ', scoreboard 'Palermo'; ep2sky/palermo; rm 'Palermo's Objective mode has been tweaked'. City centre.

maps.name: Bizerte Festung
maps.place: Bizerte, Tunisia (the old fortress by the canal)
maps.evidence: ws 'Bizerte'; ld 'Bizerte Festung'; rm 'Bizerte Fortress ... Push forward into the gem of Tunisia, Bizerte ... the streets near the canal ... the ancient fortress'. Pinned on the Kasbah/old port.

maps.name: Kasserine
maps.evidence: ld + scr header 'MP_Kasserine_TOW'; ep2sky/kasserinetow; afka_terrain cliffs. The pass. Next to campaign pin bt1.

maps.name: Monte Battaglia
maps.evidence: ld + scr header 'MP_MonteBattaglia_TOW', scoreboard 'Monte Battaglia'; tex it_terrain/battaglia*. Summit 44 13 05 N 11 34 47 E (Wikipedia, Battle of Monte Battaglia, Sept-Oct 1944).

maps.name: Monte Cassino
maps.evidence: ld + scr header 'MP_MonteCassino_TOW', scoreboard 'Monte Cassino'; ep2sky/cassino. The abbey. Same spot as campaign pin bt3.

maps.name: Anzio
maps.evidence: ld + scr header 'ANZIO'; anzio/water_anzio, ep2sky/anziobeachsky; rm 'Anzio Beach's sandy beach has been fixed'. Town/beach.

maps.name: Bizerte
maps.evidence: ld 'Bizerte'; scr header 'BIZERTE HARBOR'; ep2sky/bizerte. The harbour (shares the Bizerte location slot).

maps.name: Stuckguter
maps.place: a German cargo ship in Bizerte harbour, Tunisia
maps.evidence: ws 'Tunisia - Bizerte Harbor'; ld 'Stuckguter'; rm 'Stuckguter, a German cargo ship, is being raided by the Allies'; tex choppywater/mp_stuckguter_lib. Place certain (the ship is fictional). Shares the Bizerte slot.

maps.name: Tunisia
maps.evidence: ws 'Tunisian Desert'; ld + scr header 'TUNISIA'. Country certain, spot not: placed in the central Tunisian steppe (the 1943 battle area between Gafsa and Sfax), drawn as an area.
